sense.text:
“The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done”, “and there is no new thing under the sun.” What happened in the past is what will happen again in these last days.

The thing that hath been is man: what man does on the earth, whether he keeps God’s laws or does not keep God’s laws, is done again. That is the root of it all. A quick journey through Genesis hits the key points of what happened in the past, and the same things are being done today.

precepts.why:
“That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man.” The thing that hath been, named in Ecclesiastes 1:9, is man.

So when Solomon says “The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be”, he is speaking of what man does: whether man keeps God’s laws or does not keep them, the same works come around again, and there is no new thing under the sun.

sense.text: Adam knew Eve, and she bare Cain and then his brother Abel. “Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.”

“Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the Lord”: Cain brought fruit. Abel “brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof”, and “the Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering.” God had respect unto Abel because his offering was in accordance with Genesis 3:21, the animal sacrifice God had already given. Cain did not roll that way. Cain said, I am not going to do what God said; I am going to bring fruits and veggies.

“But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.” He got mad; he got pissed off. And the Lord said, “Why art thou wroth?” What are you mad for?

“If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted?” If you obey me, Cain, won’t I accept you? “And if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door”: if you do not obey me, disobedience is at your door.

Then it becomes a parable. “And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.” God is speaking to the spiritual demon, Satan. The thee there is Satan: unto Satan shall be Cain’s desire. Just as a woman’s desire is to her man (Genesis 3:16), Cain’s desire would be to Satan; anything Cain wanted, he would have to go to Satan for. And Satan shall rule over Cain.

So over Cain and his seed, Satan was over them. Sometimes we read about these men as if they were holy and righteous. No: this is Cain’s seed, and their desire is always unto Satan.
“Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.”

“And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city.” If Cain was the only child, having just killed his brother Abel, why would he need to build a city? There were thousands upon thousands of people already on the earth; that is why Cain built this city. He “called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.”

Remember this city: everything that follows in Cain’s line was done inside it.
“And Lamech took unto him two wives”: this is the first time multiple wives are read of in the Bible.

Jabal “was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.” You might think there is nothing wrong with that, but remember who their desire was to. This is Cain’s seed, the seed of the sinners, in Cain’s city. One son was dealing with tents and cattle: dealing in pricing and unrighteousness, buying and selling with the balances offset to the sinner’s favour (Ecclesiasticus 39:25-27 and 27:2).

Jubal “was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.” What is wrong with a little music? Remember this is a city, and in this city one son was dealing in music. It was not holy music. It was music about shake your ass, show me what you’re working with: all the songs many love, songs about murder, songs about drugs, songs about debauchery and adultery. That was going on in this city.
Tubal-cain was “an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron”: weapons. This son was making all kinds of weapons.

Lamech says “I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt”: I killed somebody, a young man, who tried to hurt me. Then, “If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.”

That goes back to verse 22 and the weapons. They did not just kill that one man. They wiped out his whole line: the sons, the daughters, the aunts, the whole lineage of whoever tried to hurt him. That is how Esau gets down: he does not just get you, he gets your wife, the kids, the grandma and the granddaddy. That is how these men roll, because of who their desire was to: Satan.

precepts.why:
“Unto Adam also and to his wife did the Lord God make coats of skins, and clothed them.” That does not mean they were walking around naked. It means God gave them a way to get forgiveness of their sin. That is animal sacrifice, introduced right there in Genesis 3:21.

God clothed them with righteousness and forgiveness. So when Abel brought “of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof”, God had respect unto him, because it was in accordance with Genesis 3:21. Cain refused the way God had given and brought fruit, and God had not respect unto him.

“Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband.” Male and female: whatever she desires, whether it is sex, wisdom, knowledge or money, it must be to her husband.

So when God says to Satan in Genesis 4:7, “And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him”, it is the same wording. Just as a woman’s desire is to her man, Cain’s desire would be to Satan. Anything Cain wanted he would have to go to Satan for, and Satan would rule over him.

“For the good are good things created from the beginning: so evil things for sinners.” “The principal things for the whole use of man’s life are water, fire, iron, and salt, flour of wheat, honey, milk, and the blood of the grape, and oil, and clothing.” “All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.”

How do sinners turn these good things into evil? Pricing. Bring it up to today: what do they do with food? GMOs. They put things inside the chickens and the cows to make them larger, and that causes sickness.

So the tents and cattle of Cain’s seed in Genesis 4:20 were not innocent. The sinners took the good things God made and turned them to evil.

“As a nail sticketh fast between the joinings of the stones; so doth sin stick close between buying and selling.” When you are dealing in business with a sinner, the balances will always be offset in his favour. He will not take a five percent interest; the sinner wants a hundred or two hundred percent.

So when Genesis 4:20 says Jabal was “the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle”, remember this is the seed of Cain: one son was dealing in tents and cattle, in pricing and unrighteousness.

John explains it. “In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil”: the children of God are on the earth, and so are the children of the devil. “Whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.”

“For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.” John was correcting the Israelites he wrote to, and here is the point: “Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother.” Don’t be like Cain. Cain was of that wicked one: Cain was under Satan, and Satan was his father.

“And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.” That is what “unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him” means: Satan ruled over Cain.

sense.text:
“And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth.” Why is it written like that? Seth was in Adam’s likeness, after Adam’s image. It never says that about Cain. Cain was of that wicked one, as 1 John 3:12 says: Cain was in the image of Satan, not in the image of Adam.

So everybody is not a child of God. Everybody comes from Adam, yes, but Satan’s kids come from Adam too. That was Cain’s lineage.

precepts.why: “And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness.” That is the point: everybody is not in God’s image. Man was made in God’s image and after his likeness, to “have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth.”

“And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.” That was Adam, and Adam was in God’s image.

So Seth, begotten in Adam’s likeness and after his image, was in the image of Adam, who was in the image of God. Cain was not in Adam’s image, and he was not in God’s image.

sense.text:
All of this is transpiring within the city called Enoch, named after Cain’s son. “The sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.” The sons of God are not angels coming down, as Christianity says; they are men, our forefathers. Before we were called Israelites, we were called the sons of God.

“They took them wives of all which they chose”: that is interracial marriage. We started to marry the women of other nations. Just like some in the room who slide a white woman in, talking about she is of the tribe of Gad. We know your wife is an Edomite.

“My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh.” That is the proof it is talking about man. How Christian scholars can read that and say angels is hard to see. God is angry with man, and the man is the sons of God: he is also flesh.

“There were giants in the earth in those days”, and when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, their children “became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.” The God spark we had made those children renowned and powerful men upon the earth, and they were battling the giants.

“God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth.” We were not righteous; we had already started breaking God’s laws within this city. “Every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.” Think about all the great cities, a New York City: murder, wicked music, buying and selling, stealing. The same thing going on now is the same thing that was going on back then. You have a wife, and you are looking over at the white woman or the Chinese woman. Same thing.
“It repented the Lord that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.” The Lord was angry: “I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth.”
“But Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord.” Noah was a just man, perfect in his generations, and walked with God; and he begat Shem, Ham and Japheth.

“The earth was filled with violence.” “The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them.” That them goes back to Cain’s seed. Cain’s seed was influencing everybody: what was read in Genesis 4 from verse 20 down about Cain’s children affected all people on the earth.
“Make thee an ark of gopher wood.” And there was a flood on the earth forty days and forty nights.

precepts.why:
In Christianity they say the sons of God in Genesis 6 are angels coming down. John says otherwise: “Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God.”

The sons of God are men, the people the Father loves. It is not talking about angels coming down.

“For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.” Everybody is waiting for our manifestation, to be called the sons of God.

So the understanding of the sons of God is talking about man. Before we were called Israelites, we were called the sons of God; and in Genesis 6 the sons of God took them wives of the daughters of other nations.

sense.text: Where did the ark land? “The ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.” That is Mount Ararat, near Turkey.

“Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.” Why replenish the earth? Because God killed everybody on the planet. Imagine that. People say God is all love; then you have never read the Bible. He is all love when you obey, but when you don’t, he is a great and terrible God.
“And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth.”

“Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you.” This is the first time meat was introduced into our diet. In Genesis 1 God said to eat the herbs and the vegetables; after the flood he introduces meat. And when God introduced meat into our diet, it went with certain carnivores as well: the lions, the tigers, the bears.
“But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.” Don’t eat anything with blood in it.

“I do set my bow in the cloud.” This is the rainbow; it was first created here, for “a token of a covenant between me and the earth”. It has nothing to do with LGBT crap. “The bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.”

precepts.why:
Before meat was introduced: “Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.” Our diet was herbs and seeds.

And “to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat.” Even the lions and the tigers and the bears ate herbs and vegetables. Nobody ate meat until Genesis 9:3.

So when they ask how come the animals didn’t eat each other, it is because their diet was herbs and vegetables.

sense.text:
“The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.” Ham was the progenitor of the dark races, but the Negroes do not come from Ham. The Nilotic tribes are very, very dark. We did mix with them, so some of them may be Shemites, but the Nilotes were dark like that. Pharaoh was Nilotic, very dark, not looking like us (a word for the art department).

Cush is the land south of Egypt: Nubia, today’s Sudan and parts of Ethiopia. Parts, because in Ethiopia you have Shemites and Hamites. What is read here in Genesis 10 are pure Hamites; they had not started mixing (we did in Genesis 6, but God killed them off).
“And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.” Nimrod came from Cush. He was a Cushite, a Nilote, an Ethiopian.
“He was a mighty hunter before the Lord”: that means he was against the Lord.
“And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel.” After the flood, the first empire was Cush: the Ethiopians, the Sudanese. Out of that land went Asshur and builded Nineveh, “a great city.”
Out of Casluhim “came Philistim”: that is who the Philistines come from.

“And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth”: this is Tyre and Zidon, read of all through the Bible, and they come from Canaan; then “the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite.”

So the first empires after the flood were Hamites. They were not ignorant and they were not dumb; these were mighty men with understanding. These damn Discovery Channel shows put white people as the first empire, and that is a lie. The Bible says the sons of Cush, the children of Ham, were the first ruling empires on the earth after the flood. Before the flood, the first city was built by Cain.

“The whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.” There was only one language on the earth, and one speech means they pronounced every word the same. No accents: everybody spoke everything the same.
They found “a plain in the land of Shinar”: this is Babylon.

“Let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven.” What was their intent? To go up to heaven. Nimrod was a mighty hunter before the Lord: they were against God. They thought they might be able to destroy God and escape any destruction that came.

“Lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth”: looking at it spiritually, they already knew what would happen. They were already going against God, and they knew in the spirit realm that God would come and scatter them, so they hurried to build.

“Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.” The Cushites, the Hamites, were not a dumb, ignorant race of people at this time. On the opposite, they were very intelligent, and they dealt in the spirit realm.
“Let us go down, and there confound their language”, “So the Lord scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth.” What they feared is what came.

“Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the Lord did there confound the language of all the earth.” Babel means confusion.

Remember Ecclesiastes 1:9: the thing that hath been is that which shall be. What Nimrod and Babel did is being done again today.

“Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”: Edom means red, the red people. “An ambassador is sent among the heathen”: we are seeing ambassadors pop up trying to organize and rally the nations against America, but nobody has fit the bill yet. “Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle”: this is going to happen.

“Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen.” They call us minorities, but God says no: those whom everybody calls white people are small among the heathen, the smallest of all nations.

“Thou art greatly despised.” People used to wonder why Israel is doing all this evil. They have been running under the guise that they are God’s chosen people for centuries. America and these white people have to do so much evil in the earth that everybody hates them, and we are seeing that now: all kinds of nations hating America and hating the Israelis.

“Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high.” They originally dwelt in Mount Seir, called Petra today, dwelling in the clefts of the rocks; then in the dark ages and middle ages, the Caucasus Mountains. They love high buildings; that is why they have skyscrapers.

“Who shall bring me down to the ground?” means, who can conquer me? It lets us know Edom would rise up as a mighty empire in these last days.

“Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle”: the eagle is the symbol of America. It was the symbol of ancient Greece, of Rome, of Spain; Britain and Germany had it at one time. They love that bird of prey.

“And though thou set thy nest among the stars”: who is doing space travel? They just sent a ship called Artemis 2 to the moon the day before yesterday. “Thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.” Esau is doing the same thing the original Babylon did, and God will bring him down.

precepts.why:
“Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the Lord.”

Babylon here is the Edom just read of in Obadiah. Mounting up to heaven is the same thing Nimrod did with the tower. And God is going to bring them down: from him the spoilers shall come.

sense.text: “I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower.” Habakkuk was in the Babylonian captivity. The princes and the king were taken away; Habakkuk was left because he was a poor prophet. He was complaining of what ancient Babylon did to us under Nebuchadnezzar, around 606 BC.

“Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.” The tables are the book, what we call the Bible today (Isaiah 30:8). And they that read run to and fro seeking the word in a famine of it (Amos 8:11-12).

“For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.” God is telling Habakkuk, though it takes long from your time period, wait for it. Sometimes we read prophecy and want it to happen in our lifetime, but God says it is for a later date. It is a long way off from Habakkuk, and we are in that time period now.

“Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him”: this is the Chaldean, the bitter and hasty nation of Habakkuk 1:6, which in the last days is the white man. “But the just shall live by his faith”: the just are the righteous, the Israelites, and they live by faith in Christ.

This prophecy is way after ancient Babylon: though Habakkuk prophesied in the days of Babylon, it is for the appointed time at the end. You might ask whether he is talking about Nebuchadnezzar; he is talking about the man raised up in the last days.

“He transgresseth by wine”: philosophies, lies. “He is a proud man”, as Obadiah said: the pride of his heart hath deceived him. “Neither keepeth at home”: does America keep at home? No. They are in everybody’s country, with over 850 bases worldwide. “Who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death”: when he takes your land he introduces democracy and Christianity, you follow all kinds of foolishness, and your whole society gets turned to hell. He “cannot be satisfied.”

“But gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people”: first he destabilizes your country and bombs your country; then he says, I am going to do you a favour, let a remnant of you come to the United States of America. That is why America is called the great melting pot.

“Shall not all these take up a parable against him”: the remnants of the nations that are here. “Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his!” Woe means destruction. Did you forget about Venezuela already? He took Venezuela and took the oil. He steals, he robs. “How long?” means how long will this go on. “And to him that ladeth himself with thick clay”: all those nations, the great melting pot gathered around him.

“Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee”: the nations that are here, whose countries were destroyed and destabilized, rising up from sleep, because there are sleeper cells here. That is terrorist activity. “And awake that shall vex thee”: they awake from sleep and vex him.

“Because thou hast spoiled many nations”: spoil means robbed, and America has robbed many nations. So “all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee”: the remnant from all those different nations that are here shall spoil him, “because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land.”

“Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high”: put up the moon. “That he may be delivered from the power of evil”: he thinks he is going to be delivered from destruction when it comes.

Isn’t that what Nimrod and them were doing? Before we get scattered, let us build a tower and get up to heaven. What is read here about today’s Babylon is the same: the same characteristics and attributes Nimrod had. NASA and private companies like SpaceX are planning a permanent human presence on the moon through the Artemis program, and they just sent up Artemis 2. Elon Musk speaks of colonizing Mars; why does Esau the Edomite want to go to Mars? Because it is the red planet.
“Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul”: this white man, Babylon, has consulted shame to his house.
“For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it”: this is destruction.

“Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!” America was built with blood: the schools, even the churches and the courthouses, stand on the bones and blood of our brothers and sisters. And did not Cain establish a city by iniquity? Ecclesiastes 1:9: that which hath been is that which shall be, and there is no new thing. It is the same thing going on.

precepts.why: To explain the tables for new people: “Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book.” The book is the Bible, what we call the Bible today. The vision Habakkuk was told to write plain upon tables is written in the book.

“That he may run that readeth it”: Amos explains it. “Behold, the days come, saith the Lord God, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the Lord.” There would be a famine of the word of the Lord.

“And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the Lord, and shall not find it.” People would travel from sea to sea; they would run to and fro to seek the word and not find it.

Ezra explains the famine. “For my son Jesus shall be revealed with those that be with him”: with him were the apostles, the followers, the disciples. “And they that remain shall rejoice within four hundred years”: from Ezra’s time to the time of Christ was four hundred years.

“After these years shall my son Christ die”: he was crucified. “And all men that have life”: all the apostles and disciples who followed him either died or were murdered and crucified by Rome. All those men and women who had understanding, dead.

“And the world shall be turned into the old silence seven days, like as in the former judgments: so that no man shall remain.” From the time after Christ and the disciples died, there was no truth being taught in the earth, nowhere. In the time of Constantine, 325 AD, you had the churches, and there was no truth there; they were worshipping idols. You had the Moors, some of them Islamic, some black Jews following the Talmud and the Kabbalah. And when the white folks rose up, it went into idolatry like you have never seen. “So that no man shall remain” means no man that had truth remained: no Israelites saying, we are the Israelites, we have to keep the commandments. You had Martin Luther and the church fathers, the damn devils; you had Tertullian, the devil who created the Trinity.

And they were travelling: the crusades going here and there trying to get the cup Christ drank from, trying to find the cross, trying to get some glimpse of understanding. They ran to and fro, as Amos said.

Who is the man whose soul is lifted up? “For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.”

Didn’t America do that? The white man came through this land and took all the dwelling places that were not theirs. And the so-called Israelis are doing the same thing over there today. The white man is doing this; he is the one lifted up whose soul is not upright in him.

“For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God”: space travel. “I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north”: that is us, in North America. “I will ascend above the heights of the clouds”: that is airplanes.

So how could the part about the clouds be true, because you see the airplanes, and the verse above it about the heavens and the stars be fake? Some say the moon is fake; is it fake like the plane you fly on, like the helicopters you see? Stop watching stupid YouTube clips. This is the one that sets his nest on high in Habakkuk 2:9 and among the stars in Obadiah 4.

sense.text: Going back to show something. Balaam “went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments”: Balaam dealt with enchantments, which lets us know he was a witch, a soothsayer, a diviner.

“And the spirit of God came upon him”: notice the little s. This is on the left-hand side; this is not righteousness coming on Balaam. The verse above says he dealt with enchantments, so the spirit with a little s is not the Holy Spirit.
“Falling into a trance, but having his eyes open”: Balaam would go into trances with his eyes wide open and see visions.

“And his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.” This kingdom that shall be exalted is the kingdom of the Lord. Agag was a tall Edomite, real tall; and the king, Christ, shall be higher than Agag (2 Esdras 2:43-47). There will be no question in the kingdom which one is the Son of God: not by an inch, but astronomically clear.

“He hath as it were the strength of an unicorn”: a unicorn is a rhinoceros. “He shall eat up the nations his enemies”: he shall destroy the nations, “and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.” Balaam saw Christ destroying the nations.
“Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.” Anybody that blesses us shall be blessed; anybody that curses us shall be cursed.
Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, because Balak the king wanted Balaam to curse us, to destroy us: “thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.”

“I cannot go beyond the commandment of the Lord, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the Lord saith, that will I speak.” Balaam knew it was the Lord sending that spirit upon him, guiding him.
“I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days”: Balaam now says, I am going to show you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.
Again, “falling into a trance, but having his eyes open”: he is a witch, a warlock, a soothsayer.

“I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh.” Balaam the witch revealed to the king that he would see Christ in the last days, but not nigh, not near, because he is not an Israelite; but he will witness what is going on.

“There shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel”: this is Christ. Christ is the star of Jacob, the king that shall rise out of Israel. He “shall smite the corners of Moab”: this king will destroy four parts of the Moabites. “And destroy all the children of Sheth”: anybody that worships the Egyptian god Seth.
“And Edom shall be a possession”: Edom shall become slaves to this people. “And Israel shall do valiantly.”

“And when he looked on Amalek”: Amalek is what is called the Israelis today. “Amalek was the first of the nations” to fight against us, “but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.” Amalek is going to be destroyed forever.
“Until Asshur shall carry thee away captive”: Asshur is the Assyrians.
“Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!” Ships shall come from Chittim and afflict Asshur and Eber, Eber of the Hebrews, “and he also shall perish for ever.”
“And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place.” And what happened to Balaam? Israel slew him (Joshua 13:22).

precepts.why:
Numbers 24:7 says his king shall be higher than Agag, and Agag was a tall Edomite. Ezra saw the king: “And in the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest, and upon every one of their heads he set crowns, and was more exalted; which I marvelled at greatly.”

Those crowned are “they that have put off the mortal clothing, and put on the immortal, and have confessed the name of God: now are they crowned, and receive palms.” And when Ezra asked, “What young person is it that crowneth them, and giveth them palms in their hands?”, the answer was, “It is the Son of God.”

So this is what Balaam saw in the spirit realm about the Israelites: their king, Christ, taller even than Agag. In the kingdom it will not be, well, he is kind of taller than that one. You will see that one there, the tallest, and that is the Son of God.

What happened to Balaam? “Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.”

What is he? The soothsayer: a witch, a warlock. God had sent his unrighteous angels down to tell that witch this and that; then God told the Israelites, kill Balaam, destroy him, he is not our people. God got tired of him and had him put to death.

precepts.why:

precepts.why:

sense.text: “And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god.” Pay attention to the wording. “For a father afflicted with untimely mourning, when he hath made an image of his child soon taken away, now honoured him as a god, which was then a dead man.” He set his son’s image up as a god, “and delivered to those that were under him ceremonies and sacrifices.”

“For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.” Why does it say beginning? Because it goes back to Adam and Eve: what was their sin? Idolatry. precepts.why:
“And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.” The white man set himself up as God and went against all God’s laws: this is the creation and function of the Roman Catholic Church.

“And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them”: Spain and Portugal made war against the saints of God, and overcame us in slavery. “And power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations”: the white man conquered everybody.

sense.text:
“And he shall speak great words against the most High”: the he here is the fourth kingdom Daniel did not understand, which the angel revealed to Ezra as the eagle with three heads: Rome, America, Britain. The great words are blasphemies.

“And shall wear out the saints of the most High.” Look at a pair of sneakers. New, they are easily identified; worn too long, they get so worn out you cannot tell what brand they were. We are no longer the glorious and mighty sons and daughters of God upon the earth, and we cannot even tell our own identity. Look at a Negro or a Latino: nobody can identify them as a race.

“And think to change times and laws.” He changed times (the new year, the months, the days, the hours, the moon), and he changed laws like the Sabbath day: the Bible says the Sabbath is the seventh day of the week; the white man says the Sabbath shall be the first.

“And they shall be given into his hand”: the Israelites given into this white man’s hands, “until a time and times and the dividing of time.” Time is singular, one; times is plural, two; and the dividing makes three and a half.

precepts.why: Dealing with changing times: “This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.” God set the beginning of the year.

“This day came ye out in the month Abib.” Abib is the name of the first month in the ancient Hebrew calendar, corresponding to parts of March and April: the end of March to the beginning of April, the spring season. The word means ear of grain, young green ears: the stage when the barley is ripe but still soft, the start of the spring harvest.

So when you see Israelites celebrating Passover in the winter, they do not know what they are talking about. The white man changed the new year from the spring to the dead of winter. That is what God warns of in Daniel 7:25: he shall think to change times.

“Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day?” There are twelve hours in the day. The white man has something called daylight saving time, where they change time forward or backward. They play with times, just as Daniel said this man would think to change times.

“Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years.” “And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day”, that is the sun, “and the lesser light to rule the night”, that is the moon; “he made the stars also.”

When Adam and Eve were created, the moon was what they call the full moon: that was the beginning. Two great lights; it was not dark with only a sliver of light. The white man says no, begin the month when it is black, or when it has one sliver of light, and that is not biblical. He changed that to confuse a lot of people, and you have Israelites who base holidays on a moon you cannot see. We did that at one time too. We are not hating; we are trying to enlighten, because we woke up.

Still dealing with times. “And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast”: the first beast was Rome. Nobody worships Rome? Really?

Look at the days of the week: Sunday, the sun; Monday, the moon; Tuesday, Mars; Wednesday, Woden, Mercury; Thursday, Thor, Jupiter; Friday, Freya, Venus; Saturday, Saturn. Look at the months: our lives run on Roman time. January is named for the Roman god Janus with two faces; February for a Roman festival of purification; March for Mars, the god of war; May and June for the goddesses Maia and Juno; July was changed by Julius Caesar after his family name, and August by the emperor Augustus after himself. September, October, November and December mean seven, eight, nine and ten, yet December is now the twelfth month.

So the whole earth keeps the times of the first beast. This white man has a lot to pay for: he changed times.

Where does a time and times and the dividing of time come from? “And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.” Revelation 11:11 explains it: a time, times and a dividing of time is three and a half.

“And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.” A thousand two hundred and threescore days is 1,260 days; divided by 360, that is three and a half. Time is one, times is two, and the dividing is the half: three and a half.

“And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.” A time, singular, and times, plural, and half a time: this is what Daniel 7:25 was talking about.

We are nourished from America. Everything we have, every place we live, the food we eat, the drinks we drink, the clothes we wear, the education we have received, has come from this white man, the dragon. And see what it calls him: the serpent.

It is saying the same thing as Revelation 12:14, but Moses does not use the word serpent. “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies”: Moses uses the word enemies, “which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger”, so you have to serve them for food, “and in thirst” for water, “and in nakedness” for clothing, “and in want of all things”: if you want anything, education, medicine, you have to go to your enemies.

“And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” That is the history Moses prophesied and John the Revelator prophesied. John called the enemy the serpent.

sense.text: With all this, they have something called Christian dispensationalism, or replacement theology: that God’s people are done away with. “I say then, Hath God cast away his people?” Paul was dealing with that back then. “God forbid”: he says no. “For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.” Paul proves the Israelites were not done away with.

precepts.why:
“Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah.” The new covenant has nothing to do with all nations: just as the old covenant was only for the twelve tribes of Israel, so is the new.

“Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake”: we broke the covenant of animal sacrifice. “Although I was an husband unto them”: God was married to us. “I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts”: that is the kingdom. “For I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more”: because of what Christ did for us.

“Thus saith the Lord, which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night”: that goes back to Genesis 1:14-16. “If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the Lord, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.” This is how the Lord loves us: if you could get rid of the sun, the moon and the stars, then the Israelites would not be his people. Nobody can get rid of the sun, the moon or the stars.

“If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel.” If you could measure the heavens and the deep: the deeper you go, the more the pressure crushes things; the white man has been trying and dying trying to get down there. God has not cast away his people.

What is being proven: God’s people are the twelve tribes of Israel; he never cast us away; and we are not to listen to the false prophet called Christianity.

“Considerest thou not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the Lord hath chosen, he hath even cast them off?” The two families are Judah and Israel, and this people is the other nations, who thought the Lord cast us off. “Thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.” Many Christian churches teach that the twelve tribes of Israel have been destroyed, that God is not dealing with them any more but with the church, and by church they mean the Roman Catholics and the Protestants.

“If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth; Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob, and David my servant, so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” That proves we are going to be rulers, because the sun is still here, the moon is still here and the stars are still here. “For I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.” He is going to have mercy on us: twelve tribes.
